FVN.EmptyLibrary: The library is empty. Create the first character.
FVN.RequiredFields: Enter a name and select an image.
FVN.CharacterNotFound: Character not found or missing an image.
FVN.ScenePreview: Drag the character to position it
FVN.DirectPositionHelp: Drag the image directly on the scene. Its position is stored as a percentage of the free canvas area.
FVN.CannotDeleteLastTab: At least one preset must remain.
FVN.NoVisibleCharacters: No character in this tab is currently on stage.
FVN.ReorderLayer: Drag to change layer order: higher in the list means further in front.
FVN.EmptyPool: The character pool is empty. Create reusable characters here.
FVN.SelectPoolCharacters: Select at least one character to add.
FVN.AddedFromPool: Added {count} copies to the current sheet.
FVN.DeletePoolConfirm: Delete {name} from the pool? The {count} copies already placed in sheets will remain available.
FVN.VariantsOptional: Optional: the character works with the main image only.
FVN.DoubleClickCollapse: Double-click to collapse or expand the window
FVN.CreateTabsFromScenesHelp: Select world scenes. A preset with the same name will be created for each scene and automatically bound to it.
FVN.DirectScaleHelp: Drag the portrait corners on the canvas to resize it. The scale slider remains available and updates automatically.
FVN.DuplicateBindingsPrompt: The original preset is bound to {count} scenes. Copy those bindings too?
FVN.DeleteTabCharacterCount: This will permanently delete {count} character instances contained in this preset.
FVN.DeleteTabPoolSafe: Character Pool entries, image files, and copies in other presets will not be changed.
FVN.DuplicateNoBindingsPrompt: This preset is not bound to any scene. Do you still want to create a copy?
FVN.CameraDragHelp: Drag to pan · Mouse wheel to zoom
FVN.CameraFocusHelp: Choose the point that should be moved to the center of the shot.
FVN.FocusRequiresVisible: The character must be visible on the Stage before it can be focused.
FVN.FocusDragHelp: Drag the frame to choose the shot; use the corner handle to adjust zoom. The crosshair marks the exact focus point.
FVN.ContextCharacterDuplicated: Duplicated a copy of {name} in the preset.
FVN.StatusHealthy: This preset is well optimized. No action is required.
FVN.StatusEmpty: Add characters to the preset to calculate its estimated load.
FVN.StatusCritical: Very high load: reduce the largest images, limit visible characters, and lower blur intensity.
FVN.StatusHeavy: Heavy preset: consider smaller WebP images and display only the characters currently needed.
FVN.StatusLargeImage: {name} uses a very large image ({width} × {height} px). Resizing it will substantially reduce the preset load.
FVN.StatusBlurAdvice: Strong blur increases GPU load. Medium intensity usually provides smoother performance.
FVN.StatusManyVisible: Many characters are visible at once. Hiding unnecessary portraits will reduce the active load.
FVN.StatusGoodVisibility: The preset contains many textures, but active load is moderate because only a few characters are visible.
FVN.WelcomeTitle: Welcome to the new version of Cast & Scene.
FVN.DoNotShowReleaseNotes: Do not show release notes again
FVN.ReleaseFeatureArchitecture: This version is compatible with Foundry VTT 14 and includes a minimal tutorial to help you get started with the module.
FVN.ReleaseFeaturePolish: Since Cast & Scene is a visual module, a Performance Monitor has been included to help you keep your scenes lightweight.
FVN.ReleaseFeatureOnboarding: Includes a first-run tutorial and versioned release notes.
FVN.ReleaseFeatureDiagnostics: Performance Monitor estimates texture memory, transfer size, visible load and background-effect cost.
FVN.ReleaseFixLayout: Polished Director and Quick Access layouts with responsive controls.
FVN.ReleaseFixConsistency: Scene activation now clears the shared Stage while simple GM scene preview does not affect players.
FVN.ReleaseFixMaintenance: Stable v14 release removes test-build labeling and keeps the production UI English-only.
FVN.TutorialPoolBody: Store reusable characters here, then copy them into any Scene Preset.
FVN.TutorialPresetsBody: Prepare casts and layouts for each scene. Right-click entries for contextual actions.
FVN.TutorialStageBody: Arrange portraits, adjust scale, and define the Camera Focus frame in this workspace.
FVN.TutorialPerformanceBody: The bar estimates transfer size, texture memory, visible load, and background-effect cost.
FVN.TutorialControlsBody: Configure background behaviour above, then use the action buttons during play.
FVN.TutorialQuickBody: Use the floating palette during the session to show portraits, focus the camera, and control names or background effects.
FVN.SpotlightRequiresVisible: Spotlight requires the character to be visible.
FVN.QuickVariantsHelp: Choose up to six images from this preset for Quick Access.

FVN.TutorialStartFailed: The tutorial could not start. Close and reopen Cast & Scene, then try again.
